title: CommitRequest
description: Which slice's worktree to commit the changed and untracked files of, and the commit's message.

folder.description: A worktree this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/worktrees/my-slice.

message.description: The commit's message: its first line is the subject. It has a character that is not a space, and no control character but tab and newline.
